purpose: Ranked primary-origin and early-signal channels used by Daily AI Brief content discovery and Emerging AI Watch.

policy.verification_required: Trace consequential claims to an original paper, model card, repository, official release, system card, or other authoritative evidence before selection.
policy.preprint_treatment: Label preprints and author-reported results as preliminary unless independent validation exists.
policy.restricted_channels: X and specialized Discord communities require assisted review; a login page, inaccessible post, or secondhand quotation is not evidence.

channels.name: arXiv — cs.AI, cs.LG, and cs.CL
channels.why_monitored: High-volume first public posting point for AI and language-model research.
channels.evidence_treatment: Primary research lead. Verify the paper, authors, submission date, methods, limitations, and later versions; preprint status is not peer review.

channels.name: X — verified researchers and AI labs
channels.why_monitored: Fast release signals, demonstrations, replication notes, and early critiques from named researchers and labs.
channels.evidence_treatment: Discovery signal only. Confirm account identity, follow every claim to original evidence, and do not treat screenshots, engagement, or reposts as validation.

channels.name: Hugging Face Hub and Daily Papers
channels.why_monitored: Open models, datasets, demos, model cards, and community discussion often appear with or before written coverage.
channels.evidence_treatment: Verify the uploader, license, model or dataset card, version, linked paper or repository, and independently relevant limitations. Popularity is not quality evidence.

channels.name: Official frontier-lab research and newsrooms
channels.why_monitored: First-party model releases, capability updates, technical reports, API changes, and system cards.
channels.evidence_treatment: Primary evidence for what a lab announces, not independent proof of comparative performance, safety, adoption, or availability.

channels.name: GitHub repositories and releases
channels.why_monitored: Code, evaluations, training recipes, inference tools, agent frameworks, and implementation evidence often appear before broad coverage.
channels.evidence_treatment: Inspect repository ownership, release or commit history, documentation, license, tests, linked paper, and reproducibility evidence. Stars are not validation.

channels.name: Reddit — r/MachineLearning and r/LocalLLaMA
channels.why_monitored: Early practitioner discussion, replication reports, open-model tests, local inference techniques, and practical failure reports.
channels.evidence_treatment: Discovery and critique signal only. Distinguish direct testing from opinion or rumor; verify releases, benchmarks, and claims at their origin.

channels.name: Hacker News
channels.why_monitored: Early technical discussion of papers, releases, repositories, and new tools, often with useful implementation caveats.
channels.evidence_treatment: Discovery and critique signal only. Trace submissions and factual claims to original evidence; comments can supply questions, not confirmation.

channels.name: Specialized AI Discord communities
channels.why_monitored: Real-time implementation discussion around research groups and model families can reveal early working examples and limitations.
channels.evidence_treatment: Discovery signal only. Use only official or verified community access, never expose private discussion, and require public original evidence before selection.

channels.name: YouTube — official labs and researchers
channels.why_monitored: Official demonstrations, paper walkthroughs, research talks, and early technical explanations can precede written coverage.
channels.evidence_treatment: Verify channel identity, upload date, runtime, claims, and linked original evidence. Demonstrations and commentary are not independent validation.

channels.name: AI conference sites and OpenReview
channels.why_monitored: Conference programs, camera-ready papers, public reviews, and author responses add scrutiny and revisions to earlier preprints.
channels.evidence_treatment: Record review stage and version. Separate accepted or camera-ready work from submissions, workshop papers, reviews, and author responses.
